text: At N=128, force gains about 0.004-0.005 per 500 steps from step 3000 to 6000 and has not levelled off (final 0.163-0.178). If seeds 20-21 are trained to 12000 steps, does force reach >= 0.20, or does it level off below 0.18? Across N=64, 128 and 256, is the final force margin better predicted by log(val_mse_ratio) than by training step?
